findings: The shelf is contributed by the S7 target shape; turning S7 off removes the lobe but reintroduces upper-arm and shoulder folds.
Surface-only smoothing in a posterior patch does not adequately change the three-quarter junction.
Local S7 attenuation improves the rear profile but brings back folds; adding local fairing does not solve both views.
R34 remains unaccepted for this visible arm-to-side contour even though its earlier numerical checks pass.

trials.rejected_reason: insufficient three-quarter improvement and visible shoulder folding

limits: These are evaluated-surface probes and software-view diagnostics, not saved Blender candidates or accepted corrections. No R35 blend was created.
proposed_scope: Re-author the S7 skin targets across the complete local upper-arm/axilla/side junction, preserving the frozen skeleton, basis, weights and non-S7 families; create separate R35 with documented tests and matched native Blender review renders/video. Ask owner first because this is a larger target-shape change.
